summary: Approved PHASE-002 design is sufficient; implement provider-neutral contracts and persistent local runtime without new human decisions.
plan: Zod provider contracts: scoped independent support/commerce/transaction/knowledge bindings, exact minor-unit money, receipts, classified failures, immutable command fingerprints.

Injectable SQLite clients, versioned reversible migrations preserving legacy cases and Mastra-owned tables, CAS and transactional uniqueness, repositories for cases/messages/actions/idempotency/dispatch/outbox.

Persistent local provider fixtures, order/subscription/refund lookup, ambiguity rejection, atomic remaining-balance checks and replay, knowledge provenance, repeatable seed and explicitly scoped reset.

Resolve tools and workflows through case-persisted registry bindings; atomically persist inbound events; bridge existing approval decision to persisted immutable command; retain existing Mastra registration/context.

Durable dispatch with stable run IDs, bounded claims and installed Mastra restart APIs; durable outbox with bounded classified retries and receipts, separate delivery status, preserve suspended approvals.
Opt-in loopback HTTP facade and transport adapter with shared conformance tests, validation, timeout/429/5xx/dropped-response injection.
Tests for actual restart, replay, concurrency, migration up/down/up, recoverable work and delivery; documented Studio startup and seed/reset; all 20 approved gates.
phase_boundaries: PHASE-003 owns principal/RBAC/native agent approval/multi-turn memory; PHASE-004 owns index swap/evals/monitoring; PHASE-005/006 own external integrations; PHASE-007 owns release. No new dependency, model substitution or external operations.
planning_constraints: Financial compatibility conversion only at checked boundary
Recovery distinguishes suspended and active work
